admin_means: an approved account whose registered role is "tech", or the account auto-approved as admin by the founder bootstrap
founder_bootstrap: The FIRST person to log into a school's portal automatically gets Jakob's approval: that first successful login auto-approves the account as the portal admin. Approval source recorded as: founder rule (Jakob).
name: Ferrum school portal
purpose: The control place for a school's Echo machines. Authorized people turn Echo off and back on here (the real STOP/START). Tech/admin accounts oversee Echo (chat with it, see its status and activity log). Teachers work their approvals inbox and see their classroom's student activity. Parents and tech departments set the Classbook home-use rules.
student_school_hours_refusal: Sorry, you're not allowed in here during school hours.
